description: The kinds of physical container used at the site, and the rules for what each may hold. A type is what a container is, not how deep it sits, so the same type is valid at any level.

fields.description: The physical container kind: Box, Case, Pallet, Tote.
fields.label: Bundle Type Name

fields.description: Retire a type without affecting bundles that already reference it.
fields.label: Disabled

fields.description: Bundle types permitted inside this one. Empty permits any.
fields.label: Allowed Child Types

fields.description: Whether Handling Units holding stock may be placed directly inside. Clear on a Pallet to require that everything is boxed first.
fields.label: Allow Loose Handling Units

fields.description: Whether everything inside must be the same kind: all Handling Units holding stock, or all one bundle type.
fields.label: Require Uniform Members

fields.description: Maximum number of things permitted inside. Zero is unlimited. A count only; no volume or weight is enforced.
fields.label: Max Members

fields.description: Prevent a bundle of this type from being packed or unpacked while it is itself inside another bundle.
fields.label: Seal When Contained

fields.description: Prevent the contents from being used on a stock transaction while still inside this bundle. Off by default, because staff legitimately open a carton and remove a single unit.
fields.label: Restrict Member Transactions

name: Handling Unit Bundle Type
